notice: Fictional movies, services, and authored provider responses; no model generated these fixtures.

sources.text: The viewer wants a light adventure movie lasting no more than 120 minutes.
Moonlight Map is a 105-minute adventure comedy. City Sprint is a 140-minute action movie.
No streaming service is recorded for Moonlight Map in this fictional catalog.

cases.label: Usable draft
cases.lesson: The application reaches review_required. The prepared draft still needs evidence review.

content.text: {"recommendation": "Try Moonlight Map: its adventure-comedy genre and 105-minute length fit the viewer's request for a light adventure under 120 minutes [S1, S2]. Streaming availability is not supplied [S3].", "streaming_service": null, "evidence_ids": ["S1", "S2", "S3"], "open_questions": ["Where can the viewer stream Moonlight Map?"]}

cases.label: Temporary service failure
cases.lesson: One attempt stops. Two total attempts recover from the prepared 503; the retry wait is recorded but skipped offline.

content.text: {"recommendation": "Try Moonlight Map: its adventure-comedy genre and 105-minute length fit the viewer's request for a light adventure under 120 minutes [S1, S2]. Streaming availability is not supplied [S3].", "streaming_service": null, "evidence_ids": ["S1", "S2", "S3"], "open_questions": ["Where can the viewer stream Moonlight Map?"]}

cases.label: Invalid credentials
cases.lesson: A prepared 401 is not retried. Repeating unchanged credentials cannot fix configuration.

cases.label: Refused response
cases.lesson: Refusal content is a distinct outcome, not a recommendation to parse or a reason to bypass the refusal.

cases.label: Incomplete response
cases.lesson: A partial answer must not become a finished recommendation. Stop and inspect the cause before changing the output budget.

cases.label: Broken JSON
cases.lesson: The parser rejects the prepared malformed text; repeating a network call is not the same as repairing content.

cases.label: Wrong field type
cases.lesson: Valid JSON still fails the recommendation contract when a streaming service is a number.

content.text: {"recommendation": "Try Moonlight Map: its adventure-comedy genre and 105-minute length fit the viewer's request for a light adventure under 120 minutes [S1, S2]. Streaming availability is not supplied [S3].", "streaming_service": 42, "evidence_ids": ["S1", "S2", "S3"], "open_questions": ["Where can the viewer stream Moonlight Map?"]}

cases.label: Unknown source ID
cases.lesson: A reference to S99 is rejected because the request supplied only S1, S2, and S3.

content.text: {"recommendation": "Try Moonlight Map: its adventure-comedy genre and 105-minute length fit the viewer's request for a light adventure under 120 minutes [S1, S2]. cases.label: Unsupported claim
cases.lesson: The false ExampleFlix availability claim passes structure and source-ID checks. review_required does not mean verified.

Streaming availability is not supplied [S3].", "streaming_service": "ExampleFlix [S1]", "evidence_ids": ["S1", "S2", "S3"], "open_questions": ["Where can the viewer stream Moonlight Map?"]}

cases.lesson: Local input validation stops before any provider call.
